author: mimo-v2.6-flash
quota: Primary balance checked against 7.2 CNY, both scorers passed a two-answer calibration. All arms regraded with backup if primary is abandoned.
sample: 40 frozen chapters, 20 pairs, 4 arms, 24 turns each, interim metric from first 12; nested horizons, no stopping-length hint
replay: Identical outbound BT messages and options for each repeat, with independent topic/session cache key; primary answers stay in the replayed history.
input_scope: Only a named chapter is specified as a topic. Unnamed followups use the current branch with no injected topic. Direct arm sends current chapter plus edits and question.
metrics: Conservative chapter-mean completeness requires both ordered source match and independent semantic correctness. Also report semantic-only and grader disagreement. CI: 10000 chapter resamples, fixed seed 20261127.
decision: At both lengths original and latest chapter means >= direct minus 3 percentage points; input per ask <= 2x retrieval. Report both prefix runs. Compare each difference with absolute same-input repeat variation. Default is decided by user.
